interests.notes: Commodity group: Copper. Stage: producing. Effective 0.8306% NSR (increased from 0.7775% via Q1 2024 acquisition of 0.0531% for $4.742M from Franco-Nevada). 2024 mine production: 124,761t Cu, 3,183t Mo. Payments received net of Chilean taxes: $6.772M for 2024.

Commodity group: Copper. Stage: producing. Timok – Cukaru Peki per MD&A; 0.3625% NSR uncapped, cannot be repurchased or reduced; covers Upper and Lower Zones. 2023 revenue included $4.783M catch-up payments for 2021-2022.

Commodity group: Precious Metals. Stage: producing. Perpetual 10% NSR on oxide zone (after 10koz cumulative GEO) and 2% NSR on sulfide zone (after 25koz cumulative GEO). Operator acquired by ACG Metals (LON:ACG) Sep 2024; sulfide expansion funded via $200M bond.
Commodity group: Polymetallic. Stage: producing.

Commodity group: Precious Metals. Stage: producing. 3.5% NSR on-site / 5% NSR off-site. Initial gold production in 2024 (10,844 oz Au, 11,388 oz Ag sold Sep-Dec). EMX credited $981,000 in 2024, 80% applied to advance royalty repayment; $196,000 recorded as royalty revenue.
Commodity group: Precious Metals. Stage: producing.

Commodity group: Precious Metals. Stage: producing. 1% GSR over portions of West Leeville, Carlin East, Four Corners, Turf, Rita K and other underground operations, Northern Carlin Trend; within Nevada Gold Mines (Barrick-Newmont JV). 2024 payments highest since 2012 acquisition.
Commodity group: Copper. Stage: Minera Pampa de Cobre. Acquired Dec 2024: 1% NSR for $10M, bringing total to 2% NSR over ~26,000 ha Chapi property, Minera Pampa de Cobre. Mine restart stage.
Commodity group: Copper. Stage: Gruvaktiebolaget Viscaria. Effective 0.5-1.0% NSR. FS expected April 2025; land allocation final after Swedish Land and Environmental Court of Appeal ruling Dec 2024.
Commodity group: Precious Metals. Stage: AbraSilver Resources. PFS-level silver-gold project; $7M property payment due from AbraSilver in 2025.

Commodity group: Copper. Stage: Aftermath Silver. Sliding-scale NSR acquired 2021 via SSR royalty portfolio transaction. EMX received $2.9M early earn-in repayment Dec 2024; final $3.25M due Nov 2026 (amended agreement).
Commodity group: Polymetallic. Stage: GR Silver Mining Ltd.
Commodity group: Precious Metals. Stage: Aftermath Silver.
Commodity group: Copper. Stage: Arizona Sonoran Copper. ASCU bought down NSR from 1.5% to 0.5% in Dec 2024 for $500,000 cash; royalty covers 158 acres of NE portion of Parks/Salyer.
Commodity group: Polymetallic. Stage: Virtus Mining/ Trafigura. 6% NPI increasing to 10% once $165M in revenue received by EMX; acquired 2021 via SSR royalty portfolio transaction.
Commodity group: Precious Metals. Stage: Canadian Gold Corp.
Commodity group: Battery Metals. Stage: GT Resources Inc.
